Token symbol string (FDC).
Token name string (Fondo Network).
Token decimals (18).
Total token supply; reduced by burn.
Mapping of holder address to token balance.

Checked division helper using SafeMath.

onlyOwner function staging a new owner address.
Claims ownership if msg.sender equals newOwner, then resets newOwner.
Token constructor minting the entire supply to owner.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Returns the balance of a given token holder.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient.
Sets the allowance msg.sender grants to a spender.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during construction.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
msg.sender identifies the account whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner recorded in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner recorded before the external call in approveAndCall.
msg.sender is the account whose balance is burned and pre-checked with require.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of the external receiveApproval callback.
transferOwnership stores the new pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and finally zeroes it.
acceptOwnership writes newOwner into owner, completing the ownership transfer.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token decimals.
Constructor mints _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the whole supply to balances[owner].
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
transfer updates both sender and recipient entries of balances.
transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) through SafeMath.sub.
transfer performs balances[to].add(tokens) through SafeMath.add.
approve writes the tokens value into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom updates the from and to entries of balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom subtracts the amount via SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom adds the amount via SafeMath.add.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the requested allowance into allowed.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted external receiveApproval call after updating state.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates to the arbitrary token contract's transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token sends rescued tokens to the owner address.
burn decrements balances[msg.sender] with unchecked raw subtraction.
burn decrements _totalSupply with unchecked raw subtraction.
The unchecked decrement mutates the balances mapping entry of msg.sender.
The unchecked decrement mutates the _totalSupply state variable.
burn reads balances[msg.sender] in its require guard.
The called spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions before it returns.
The arbitrary token contract called by transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter the contract during the external call.
Parameter _newOwner flows into newOwner via transferOwnership.
Parameter to is the credited recipient in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transfer.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value stored in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the moved amount in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender is both the allowance recipient and the callback target in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value cached in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter data is attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to the untrusted spender contract.
Parameter tokenAddress is used as the target of the external ERC20 call.
Parameter tokens is forwarded as the amount to the external ERC20 transfer.
Parameter _value drives the require guard and both unchecked subtractions in burn.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to feed the transferOwnership state write and should be collapsed into that function node.
Parameter to of transfer is a transient argument of the transfer function.
Parameter tokens of transfer is a transient argument of the transfer function.
Parameter spender of approve only indexes the allowed mapping inside approve.
Parameter tokens of approve is a transient argument of the approve function.
Parameter from of transferFrom is a transient argument of the transferFrom function.
Parameter to of transferFrom is a transient argument of the transferFrom function.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom is a transient argument of the transferFrom function.
Parameter tokenOwner is only a lookup key for allowance.
Parameter spender is only a lookup key for allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall is a transient argument that also becomes the callback target.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall is a transient argument of the approval state update.

Parameter tokenAddress is only the target of the unsafe external ERC20 transfer call.
